from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path('/mnt/data/spreadsheet/48983/1_48983_input.xlsx')
output_path = Path('/mnt/data/outputs/48983_0_caff126b/1_48983_output.xlsx')

wb = load_workbook(input_path, data_only=False)
ws = wb['Hárok1']

# Source (blue) table layout inferred from the sheet:
# Categories are in C4:I4, brands are in B5:B..., values are in C:I.
src_cat_row = 4
src_cat_cols = range(3, 10)     # C:I
src_brand_col = 2               # B

# Destination (red) table:
# Categories are in M4:S4, brands are in L6:L11 for the requested answer range.
dst_cat_row = 4
dst_cat_cols = range(13, 20)    # M:S
dst_brand_col = 12              # L
dst_rows = range(6, 12)         # 6:11

# Build lookup maps from the source table.
category_to_col = {
    ws.cell(src_cat_row, c).value: c
    for c in src_cat_cols
    if ws.cell(src_cat_row, c).value is not None
}

brand_to_row = {}
for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1):
    brand = ws.cell(r, src_brand_col).value
    if brand is not None and str(brand).strip() != "":
        brand_to_row[brand] = r

# Fill only M6:S11 with literal values from the source blue table.
for r in dst_rows:
    brand = ws.cell(r, dst_brand_col).value
    for c in dst_cat_cols:
        category = ws.cell(dst_cat_row, c).value
        value = None
        if brand in brand_to_row and category in category_to_col:
            value = ws.cell(brand_to_row[brand], category_to_col[category]).value
        ws.cell(r, c).value = value

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

# Verification: print the written range M6:S11.
wb_check = load_workbook(output_path, data_only=False)
ws_check = wb_check['Hárok1']
for r in range(6, 12):
    print([ws_check.cell(r, c).value for c in range(13, 20)])
